verdict.rationale: The evidence shows simulated RTX and physics-based sensors in Isaac Sim, a ROS bridge, and Isaac ROS perception and localization packages. None of it documents ready-made drivers for physical cameras, lidars, IMUs, or GPS, or the standard message types used to integrate them. Simulated sensors and downstream perception packages are adjacent features, not hardware sensor drivers.

support.subject: As a robotics engineer, I can integrate cameras, lidars, IMUs, and GPS with ready-made drivers and standard message types
